searchLedger.hypothesis: the forbidden-attribution filter may reach the subject line and delete authored content

searchActions.result: filter runs from index 0 with no subject guard; writer then emits only the trailer

searchLedger.rationale: subject can match FORBIDDEN_KEY_RE and is dropped

searchLedger.hypothesis: cherry-pick id re-mint may not trigger for the source values git actually passes

searchActions.result: clean cherry-pick invokes source=[message]; detection requires source=commit

searchLedger.rationale: copied Commit-Id survives for clean and continued picks

searchLedger.hypothesis: comment stripping may disagree with git cleanup modes for -m/-F messages

searchActions.result: both strip hash lines unconditionally; stored-message validation is raw

searchLedger.rationale: valid -m commits can be blocked and stored trailers mis-ordered

searchLedger.hypothesis: staged-file gate may validate uncommitted content instead of the index blob

searchActions.result: checker runs on $REPO_ROOT/$file (worktree), never on git show :file

searchLedger.hypothesis: new-branch rev range anchored on argv remote may fail to exclude published commits

searchActions.result: --remotes=<argv> matches nothing for URL pushes; range then spans all reachable history

searchLedger.rationale: legitimate branch creation can be blocked by legacy published commits

searchLedger.hypothesis: validator exit codes may be conflated into one misleading block message

searchActions.result: if ! node treats every non-zero exit as a rule violation

searchLedger.rationale: exit 2 (cannot check) tells the author to reword commits

searchLedger.hypothesis: id uniqueness may not distinguish a rewrite copy from an unrelated duplicate

searchActions.result: owner lookup uses git log --all --not HEAD with no author/date matching

searchLedger.rationale: pre-rebase copies on other refs block legitimate commits

searchLedger.hypothesis: contract-dir resolution may honor invocation-scoped config and disable enforcement

searchActions.result: git config --get includes command scope (git -c, GIT_CONFIG_*)

searchLedger.rationale: commit-time and push-time gates can disagree about the contract

searchLedger.invariant: a repository other than the hooks' own checkout must not control executed hook code

searchActions.result: sentinel in the target repository selects SOURCE_ROOT; hook-flags.sh and libs are then sourced from it

searchLedger.deferredReason: trust boundaries belong to D2 security, the next iteration; prior P0 candidate to re-confirm there
searchLedger.rationale: P0-class surface left unclassified in the correctness dimension by design

searchLedger.hypothesis: deletion counts or thresholds could be coerced into wrong comparisons

searchActions.result: counts digit-sanitized, threshold non-numeric falls back to 100, verdict fail-open

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: no coercible path found; every oddity fails open

searchLedger.hypothesis: skgit.contractDir could redirect rule loading outside the repository

searchActions.result: values resolve against repo root and require existence; only reads templates

searchLedger.rationale: traversal has no sink inside the target

searchLedger.hypothesis: installer could overwrite or remove hooks owned by other tools

searchActions.result: is_our_symlink requires resolution into this repo's hook source dirs; others skipped

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: ownership check covers both install and uninstall paths
searchLedger.rationale: no overwrite path for foreign hooks
